Maria (Sales): Heads up — TitanHealth POC goes live next Wed. They want a Dedicated pool and we need temporary headroom for overnight ingest tests. Request: increase pool to +4 GPUs for ~48h starting 1960500000. Also need pricing for burst vs short reserved, ability to pin route to this pool, and API key + IP allowlist. Any blockers?
Sam (Solutions Eng): Ok. Two options: ephemeral burst credits (fast) or temporary pool resize (safer for throughput). For a 48h heavy ingest I recommend temp resize: autoscale min=2 max=6. Example autoscale policy I’d apply:```json
{
  "policy": "cpu_based",
  "min_replicas": 2,
  "max_replicas": 6,
  "scale_up_threshold": 0.75,
  "scale_down_cooldown_s": 120,
  "burst_until": 1960586400
}
```
Use route pinning: route=pool:poc-titan on the customer API key to keep traffic on the POC pool. Burst credits are billed at ~1.5x token rate; temp resize will be charged at instance-hour rate (I’ll get exact numbers).
Jordy (Infra): I can execute the resize but need: 1) cost-center approval or sales PO, 2) exact pool id (poc-titan?), 3) start/end epoch. Also confirm whether they need VPC/private peering or hosted access only. If hosted: we can create a service account and scoped API key with IP allowlist. If VPC: will need a scheduled peering window and network checklist.
Maria (Sales): Pool id is poc-titan-001. Client prefers hosted (no peering) but wants IP restriction to their CIDR 203.0.113.0/24. Cost center will be submitted today. Start: 1960500000, end: 1960672800 (48h). Can you queue it?
Kevin (SRE): Quick note: autoscale max=6 on p4d-equivalent may push cluster headroom. Jordy - do you want to use burst-until field or run an explicit one-off resize command? I prefer explicit so we can revert automatically. Also we should set graceful drain window to 300s for demo.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Good call. Command I usually send infra to run:```bash
infractl pools resize --id poc-titan-001 --min 2 --max 6 --graceful-drain 300 --expires 1960672800 --reason "TitanHealth POC 48h ingest"
```
That creates a ticket and sets expiry. Also creating an API key: give me the display name and allowed routes. I’ll request key with route pin and IP allowlist.
Jordy (Infra): I can run that once PO is attached to the ticket. Also will add a temporary quota guard to prevent runaway token spend. Need the client contact for billing communication.
Maria (Sales): Billing contact is emily.t@titanhealth.com. Display name for key: titan-poc-sales-key. Allowed routes: text.generate, embeddings.create. IP allowlist: 203.0.113.0/24.
Kevin (SRE): I'll pre-approve the graceful-drain and quota guard. Jordy: flag me when you apply so I can monitor latency and evict unhealthy nodes.
Jordy (Infra): Filing internal change now. If cost center and PO land before EOD I can schedule apply for tomorrow midnight UTC.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Pricing update for Maria: burst credits used via API are billed at 1.5x token rates and do not require a commit; temporary pool resize is billed at instance-hour rates and will appear on reserved line items. If they want predictability, offer a 1-week reserved commit with a one-off discount — I’ll DM exact numbers.
Deploy Bot: [automated] change-request created: CR-5872 by Sam (Solutions Eng) -> resize request for poc-titan-001 (min=2,max=6,expires=1960672800).
Maria (Sales): Thanks all — I’ll upload the PO to CR-5872 and confirm the customer's signature. Please ping me if anything blocks the midnight apply. :thumbsup:
Jordy (Infra): Acknowledged. I’ll hold until PO is attached and then run the infractl command. Expect status updates in CR-5872.
Kevin (SRE): One more — if they later request Private/VPC we’ll need 72h for network prep. For this hosted flow, we’re good.
Maria (Sales): Noted. Will stick to hosted for now.
Sam (Solutions Eng): I’ll follow up with a short invoice estimate and the API key once the PO is attached.
Jordy (Infra): Done for now, standing by.
